northwind.name: Northwind Studio
northwind.about: A small studio shipping websites for clinics, cafes, and neighborhood brands.

brightline.name: Brightline Co.
brightline.about: We build tracking tools for freight teams across the Philippines.

jobs.title: Inbox and calendar virtual assistant
jobs.expn: New to this kind of work, or a few projects in
about: Sort a shared inbox, draft replies for approval, and keep two calendars from colliding. About 15 hours a week, weekday mornings in Philippine time.
You should be comfortable in Gmail and Google Calendar. A short writing sample in your application is enough.
doo: Sort and label a shared inbox every morning
Draft replies for approval
Keep two calendars from overlapping and confirm meetings
Flag anything urgent in the team chat
look: Comfortable in Gmail and Google Calendar
Reliable internet and a quiet place to work
nice: Experience supporting a founder or small agency
jobs.stand: Include a short writing sample, like a polite reply declining a meeting.

jobs.title: Write 40 product descriptions
jobs.expn: New to this kind of work, or a few projects in
about: We are listing packing supplies in a new store. Each product needs a 60–90 word description and a one-line summary. We will send a sheet with specs and photos.
doo: Write a 60–90 word description for each of 40 products
Write a one-line summary for each product
Follow the specs and photos we send in a shared sheet
Make one round of edits after our review
look: Able to deliver all 40 descriptions within two weeks
nice: Basic SEO knowledge for product pages
jobs.stand: Write a sample description for a roll of packing tape (60–90 words) and include it in your application.

jobs.title: Social media manager for a three-cafe group
jobs.expn: Solid experience and a portfolio to show
about: Post four times a week across Instagram and Facebook, reply to comments on weekdays, and send a short monthly note on what actually got people in the door.
Photos come from the cafes. You write the lines and keep the calendar. This is a monthly retainer, not a one-off campaign.
doo: Post four times a week on Instagram and Facebook
Reply to comments and messages on weekdays
Keep a shared content calendar two weeks ahead
Send a short monthly report on what brought people in
look: Experience running social accounts for a food or retail brand
Clear, friendly writing in English and Filipino
Comfortable with Canva or similar for simple edits
nice: Lives in or near Manila and can visit the cafes now and then
Experience with Meta Business Suite scheduling
jobs.stand: Link to an account you have managed and tell us about one post that worked, and why.

jobs.title: Redesign a clinic booking website
jobs.tz: Any, with 2 hours overlap with Philippine time
jobs.expn: Solid experience and a portfolio to show
about: Northwind is rebuilding the site for a two-location dental clinic. The current booking form asks for too much, and staff retype appointments into a spreadsheet.
We need a homepage, a services page, and a booking flow in Figma. Development is a separate hire. Please show one healthcare or local-service project in your application.
doo: Audit the current site and booking form
Design the homepage, services page, and booking flow in Figma
Prototype the booking path so staff can click through it
Hand off a clean file with notes for the developer
look: At least one healthcare or local-service project you can show
Comfortable running a short review call with clinic staff
Strong Figma skills, including components and auto layout
nice: Experience with appointment or scheduling products
Basic understanding of accessibility for older patients
jobs.stand: Share one healthcare or local-service project and tell us what you changed and why.

jobs.title: React dashboard for shipment tracking
jobs.tz: Overlap with 9 AM to 1 PM Philippine time
jobs.expn: Deep experience, works with little direction
about: Brightline needs an internal dashboard: filter shipments, see status, and open a timeline for one delivery. The API already exists.
Hourly, about 60 hours to a first version. We care more about tables that stay fast than about decoration.
doo: Build a shipment list with filters, sorting, and search
Create a timeline view for a single delivery
Connect to our existing REST API
Keep tables fast with thousands of rows
look: Experience building data-heavy tables or dashboards
Comfortable working from an existing API without a designer
nice: Experience with TanStack Table or similar
jobs.stand: Share a dashboard you built and tell us how you kept it fast.
